cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Lake George, NY for Thanksgiving week, November 26–28, 2026, for a group of six adults.

specialist.summary: Your Thanksgiving week at Lake George features three days of scenic Adirondack activities—historic steamboat cruises, lake kayaking, whitewater rafting, casual mini-golf, and lakeside dining at seasonal restaurants.

stops.title: Arrival & Scenic Drive
stops.description: Begin your Thanksgiving week at Lake George. Take time to settle into your accommodation and explore the scenic shoreline drive along Route 9, which offers views of the historic lake and surrounding Adirondack mountains.

stops.title: Lake George Steamboat Company
stops.description: Founded in 1817 as a commercial shipper, the Lake George Steamboat Company operates three authentic passenger vessels for cruises up and down the lake. This local attraction showcases the lake's natural beauty and is a notable way to experience Lake George's "claim to fame." Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Mario's Restaurant
stops.description: This Italian restaurant has been serving guests since 1954 and features a full-service bar. Reservations are advised as it is popular. Note: Dinner offered M-Th from 4:30 PM. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Lake George Kayak Company
stops.description: Paddle out on your own to explore the lake from the water. Located at Boathouse Lane in Bolton Landing, this outfitter allows you to experience the lake at your own pace. Watch the wind direction carefully, as it can significantly impact paddling time when heading back to shore. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Adirondack Adventures Whitewater Rafting
stops.description: Head to the North River for whitewater rafting adventures. Located on New York Route 28 in Johnsburg, this outfitter offers an exhilarating way to experience the Adirondack wilderness. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Sushi Yoshi
stops.description: Enjoy hibachi steakhouse dining with Chinese and Japanese cuisine. This restaurant features authentic low tables situated over hollow pits for Japanese izakaya-style dining. Open lunch and dinner seven days a week. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Scenic Lake Walk & Local Exploration
stops.description: Spend the morning walking along the Lake George waterfront or exploring the downtown area. Browse local shops and enjoy the peaceful Adirondack atmosphere.

stops.title: Pirate's Cove Adventure Golf or Gooney Golf
stops.description: Choose between two mini-golf experiences. Pirate's Cove Adventure Golf offers newer obstacles and nicer greens (more expensive), while Gooney Golf features classic old-fashioned windmill-type obstacles. Both provide casual, family-friendly fun. Confirm locations and hours on your dates.

stops.title: Pizza Jerks
stops.description: Visit this New York-style pizzeria serving delicious pizza, chicken wings, and garlic knots. Also offers delivery. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

cases.task: Build a two-day itinerary for Harpers Ferry, WV, November 14–15, 2026, for two adults.

specialist.summary: A two-day Harpers Ferry itinerary exploring the Civil War historic district, John Brown's Fort, battlefield sites, and scenic river overlooks within the national historical park.

stops.title: Visitor Center orientation and shuttle to Lower Town
stops.description: Begin at the Harpers Ferry National Historical Park Visitor Center for orientation exhibits about the site's Civil War and John Brown's raid history, then take the shuttle down to the historic Lower Town area. NPS shuttle service available; confirm current hours and fees.

stops.title: Lower Town historic district and John Brown's Fort
stops.description: Explore the restored 19th-century buildings and structures in the historic district. John Brown's Fort (Engine House) is the focal point—a reconstructed building from John Brown's 1859 raid. Tour period buildings and learn about the town's industrial and military heritage.

stops.title: The Point river-confluence viewpoint
stops.description: Head to this scenic overlook where the Shenandoah and Potomac rivers meet. The viewpoint offers views of the surrounding landscape and is especially pleasant in late afternoon light before dusk.

stops.title: Bolivar Heights battlefield walk
stops.description: Explore the Civil War battlefield site at Bolivar Heights, adjacent to Lower Town. The area includes interpretive markers describing the 1862 Battle of Harpers Ferry engagement. A walking route allows visitors to survey the terrain and fortifications from that period.

stops.title: Hiking and scenic trails in Harpers Ferry National Historical Park
stops.description: The park offers various walking and hiking trails beyond the main historic area. Options range from short walks to longer routes exploring the surrounding ridges and valleys. Trail conditions vary seasonally; confirm current conditions with NPS before departing.

sources.title: Harpers Ferry National Historical Park — NPS Official Plan Your Visit

cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for San Juan, Puerto Rico, December 4–6, 2026, for two adults.

specialist.summary: Spend three days in San Juan exploring Old San Juan's historic colonial sites and museums, enjoying Caribbean beaches, and choosing between rainforest hikes and bioluminescent bay kayaking, with flexible activity options and dining at local Puerto Rican restaurants.
specialist.reason: Task completed using Wikivoyage guide data, activity search results, and best-practice itinerary structuring for the three-day December 4–6, 2026 trip.

stops.title: Arrive in San Juan & explore Old San Juan
stops.description: Settle into your accommodation and begin your discovery of Old San Juan's colorful colonial streets. Start with the iconic pastel-colored buildings and narrow alleyways that define this historic district. Visit the San Juan National Historic Site featuring Castillo San Cristóbal (one of the largest Spanish fortresses in the New World) with its visitor center at 501 Norzagaray St, open 9AM–5PM ($10/day for adults, children under 15 free). Confirm it's open on your dates. Also explore El Castillo San Felipe del Morro, a 16th-century citadel on the northwestern point, and El Castillo de San Cristóbal, built to protect against land-based attacks—both are part of the National Historic Site. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Cultural landmarks & Casa Blanca museum
stops.description: Continue exploring Old San Juan's colonial heritage. Visit the Alcaldia (City Hall, built in 1602) on Calle de San Francisco, and Casa Blanca, the ancestral home of the Ponce de León family now serving as a museum at the western end of Calle San Sebastián (Wed–Sun 8:30AM–noon and 1:30–4PM; $5 adults, $3 seniors/students/children). Confirm it's open on your dates. Walk past La Fortaleza (the official residence of Puerto Rico's Governor, built 1533–1540) at the western end of Calle Fortaleza, and the San Juan Cathedral at 153 Calle Cristo, which contains the tomb of Juan Ponce de León and dates to the 1520s. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Dinner at a local restaurant
stops.description: Experience Puerto Rican cuisine at El Asador, The Grill Old San Juan (350 San Francisco St, daily 10AM–4AM), a two-level restaurant with exterior patio serving Puerto Rican fare at the entrance of Old San Juan. Confirm it's open on your dates. Alternatively, try La Bombonera (259 Viejo, C. de San Francisco, 7:30AM–8PM) for authentic local cuisine, fresh pastries, and superlative coffee in an unassuming landmark atmosphere. Confirm it's open on your dates.

days.mealPick: El Asador, The Grill Old San Juan (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Museums & colonial architecture
stops.description: Spend your morning visiting San Juan's museums. Visit the Cuartel de Ballaja (completed 1863, chapel added 1881), now home to Las Americas Museum containing Caribbean and European American arts and artifacts (Wed–Fri 9AM–noon and 1–4PM, Sat–Sun 11AM–4PM; $6 adults, $4 seniors/students/children at https://www.museolasamericas.org/). Confirm it's open on your dates. Also explore La Casa del Libro, a museum of art and history books spanning five centuries with nearly 5,000 early works and manuscripts dating back to the 15th century, located at 255 Calle del Cristo (Tue–Fri 11AM–5PM, Sat 11:30AM–5:30PM at https://www.lacasadellibro.org/). Confirm it's open on your dates. The Museo de San Juan (150 Calle Norzagaray 3er piso) covers the history of San Juan. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Condado beach day
stops.description: Head to Condado Beach for a relaxing afternoon by the Caribbean Sea. Enjoy the golden sand, warm waters, and laid-back beach atmosphere. This is a free activity perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and taking in the coastal scenery.

stops.title: Dinner with ambiance
stops.description: For an intimate evening experience, dine at Ostra Cosa (154 Calle del Cristo, daily noon–10PM), where reservations are recommended as it offers one of the most sensual and romantic ambiences in Old San Juan. Confirm it's open on your dates. Alternatively, enjoy great burgers and a selection of over 40 beers at BUNS Burger Shop (1214 Ashford Ave., 11:30AM–4AM). Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Old San Juan walking tour & adventure activities
stops.description: Begin with a guided Old San Juan walking tour ($25 per person) to deepen your understanding of the historic district's colonial history and architecture. This is an excellent way to learn local stories and insider details about the colorful neighborhood.

stops.title: Choose your adventure: rainforest or bioluminescent bay
stops.description: Select one of two memorable outdoor experiences: El Yunque rainforest hike ($60 per person) for a chance to explore lush tropical vegetation, waterfalls, and Puerto Rico's natural beauty, or Bioluminescent bay kayak in Fajardo ($65 per person) to paddle through glowing waters illuminated by bioluminescent organisms. Both offer unique connections to Puerto Rico's natural wonders.

stops.title: Departure or final exploration
stops.description: Depending on your flight time, enjoy a final stroll through Old San Juan, grab last-minute souvenirs, or relax before heading to the airport. Consider visiting a local grocery store like Super Max (Calle Julian Blanco, 24/7) or Freshmart (1310 Avenida Ashford) for snacks and provisions.

stops.title: Rum distillery tour
stops.description: Explore Puerto Rico's famous rum heritage with a guided distillery tour ($35 per person) that accommodates vegetarian and gluten-free diets.

stops.title: Continue exploring beaches or rainforest
stops.description: Based on interest and energy levels, either return to Condado Beach for more relaxation, revisit Old San Juan, or undertake the El Yunque rainforest hike ($60 per person) for an immersive nature experience among waterfalls and lush vegetation.

stops.title: Final evening in San Juan
stops.description: Spend your last evening enjoying the island's nightlife or dining scene. Old San Juan remains the heart of nightlife, with numerous restaurants and bars open late into the evening. Reflect on your Puerto Rico adventure before your departure.
